title: Seven people killed after twin earthquakes off coast of Philippines
summary: Quakes of 7.4 and 6.8 magnitude trigger tsunami alerts as people living near coast advised to evacuate Two powerful offshore earthquakes struck off the coast of the southern Philippines on Friday, killing at least seven people, while towns near the epicentre suffered structural damage and authorities warned of strong aftershocks. The first quake of magnitude 7.4, in waters off the town of Manay in the province of Davao Oriental, triggered a tsunami alert for coasts within 186 miles (300km) of the epicentre, but the warnings for the Philippines and Indonesia were subsequently lifted.
